title: Beginning-to-end service and route-related mentions
summary: This topic is loosely clustered around beginning/end phrasing, with clear praise for sales or service at the start or throughout the process but many fragments too brief or context-poor to assign a definite sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise attentive sales or service experiences from the beginning to the end of the purchase journey and one owner says they are growing to like the car more over time.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mainly use beginning/end wording or mention route, design, usability, or comfort issues without enough context to classify sentiment confidently.

limitations: The topic mixes several unrelated subjects, including purchase journey wording, route guidance, higher-end model comparisons, exterior design, and entry comfort.
Many fragments are extremely short or context-limited, so sentiment is often undetermined and examples are insufficient to form a tighter thematic conclusion.
Samples are stratified and not representative, so they should not be treated as estimates of how common these remarks are in the full review set.
